audit.why: Favoured framing is right: Yuumi brings no CC or burst pre-6 and Swain's Q pressure and R drain out-value her heal-only kit the whole game.
packet.levelChart, full phases[].side and content win[] all already agree Swain wins every stage — no chart edit needed here.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never states that Yuumi's R Final Chapter is an interruptible channel that Swain's E Nevermove cancels outright, even though the untargetable-dodge-burst point is already covered by dosFull[0].
audit.why: Knowing E cancels the channel changes how you play around her ult instead of just avoiding it.
audit.corrected: Added the channel-interrupt fact with Yuumi's real R cooldown (120/110/100s) to breakdown.cooldowns.
